original_question: Mark ya kasance editan-kwafi. A sati daya yana gyara adadin jimloli daidai na mawallafa biyu daban-daban, waɗanda kowannensu ke biyansa adadin farashi daban-daban na kowace jimla. Mawallafin B yana biyan Mark sau biyu na abinda Mawallafin A ke biyan sa. Mark yana gyara jimillar jimlolin 1000 kowane mako, kuma Mawallafin A yana biyan shi cent 5 a kan kowace jimla. Nawa ne Mark yake samu a cikin mako guda, a lissafin cent?
